set.body:
Objective

Reconstruct or project the global neural evidence operator from complete node-edge frame blocks under explicit frame conditions.

Scope and deliverables

- Assemble the complete measured block form C_H for declared finite frames.
- Implement Parseval reconstruction and canonical-dual reconstruction for full-column-rank left and right frames.
- Implement pseudoinverse projection for incomplete frames with an explicit projected-operator result.
- Diagnose frame rank, singular spectrum, condition number, reconstruction residual, edge completeness, and regularization.
- Distinguish exact algebraic reconstruction, numerically certified reconstruction, projected reconstruction, and rejected ill-conditioned reconstruction.
- Prevent diagonal-only maps or missing edge sets from claiming tomographic completeness.

Acceptance evidence

- Parseval fixtures reconstruct Q_H to the declared tolerance.
- General full-rank dual frames reconstruct Q_H and obey independent left/right reversal.
- Rank-deficient frames return only the correct projected operator.
- Missing blocks, incompatible bases, or unacceptable conditioning cannot claim losslessness.
- Complete node plus edge blocks outperform diagonal-only information in explicit counterexamples.
- Resource preflight prevents accidental dense whole-brain reconstruction.

Ownership boundary

Own advanced reconstruction and diagnostics over measurement forms. It remains experimental until certification.

Deferred non-goals

No two-sided experimental tomography, inverse-problem regularization research program, anatomical interpolation, or claim of stable recovery for arbitrary searchlight frames.
set.title: Epic 8: Implement dual-frame reconstruction and spatial tomography diagnostics
